approvals.generator.label: GENERATOR ID
approvals.generator.description: Generator site key (G01). Stable across account systems; the graph resolves accounts to it.

approvals.generator.label: GENERATOR NAME
approvals.generator.description: Legal name of the generating company at this site.

approvals.generator.label: EPA ID
approvals.generator.description: EPA identification number of the site. A site can carry two over time when a new owner re-notifies (Saltgrass Crossing, 1 Feb 2026).

approvals.generator.label: SITE TOWN
approvals.generator.description: Town and state of the generating site.

approvals.generator.label: VALID TO
approvals.generator.description: End of this ownership period; null for the current owner.

approvals.customer_account.label: ACCOUNT ID
approvals.customer_account.description: Account number: C-10nnn, or CE-2nnn for a Coastline customer migrated with its number kept.

approvals.customer_account.label: ACCOUNT NAME
approvals.customer_account.description: Customer name as this system spells it. A broker is a customer, not a generator.

approvals.customer_account.label: GENERATOR ID
approvals.customer_account.description: The generator the account ships for; null for a broker (brokers ship for several generators).

approvals.customer_account.label: ACCOUNT MANAGER
approvals.customer_account.description: Account manager responsible for the relationship.

approvals.customer_account.label: OPENED ON
approvals.customer_account.description: Date the account was opened in this system.

approvals.profile.label: PROFILE ID
approvals.profile.description: Profile number (WP-20417). Unique within VLS core only: Coastline used the same format and reused WP-20233 for a different stream.

approvals.profile.label: ACCOUNT ID
approvals.profile.description: Account the profile was submitted under.

approvals.profile.label: FACILITY ID
approvals.profile.description: Receiving facility the profile is approved for (FAC-BR, FAC-SF).

approvals.profile.label: PFAS FLAG
approvals.profile.description: True when the profile declares PFAS-bearing content (EPA Method 1633 results on file or declared by the generator).

approvals.profile_version.label: VERSION
approvals.profile_version.description: Version number. A newer draft does not supersede a certified version.

approvals.profile_version.label: CERTIFIED ON
approvals.profile_version.description: Date the generator certified this version.

approvals.profile_version.label: RECERT DUE
approvals.profile_version.description: Annual re-certification due date. Null on 9 migrated Coastline profiles — unknown, not current.

approvals.profile_version.label: WASTE CODES
approvals.profile_version.description: RCRA waste codes declared, comma-separated (D002, F003 …).

approvals.profile_version.label: BASIS
approvals.profile_version.description: Basis of the characterization: lab analysis, generator knowledge, or both. A generator-knowledge value is declared, not measured.

approvals.profile_version.label: SPECIFIC GRAVITY
approvals.profile_version.description: Declared specific gravity at 60 °F — the density basis for converting weighed pounds to gallons.

approvals.profile_version.label: PROCESS DESCRIPTION
approvals.profile_version.description: Generator's description of the generating process. Confidential business information: hidden from billing roles.

approvals.profile_version.label: LAB REPORT REF
approvals.profile_version.description: Laboratory report the characterization rests on, where there is one.

approvals.approval.label: PERMIT UNIT
approvals.approval.description: Permit unit code that receives the stream (RT, TFA, TFB, CSA) — the same codes as facility.permit_unit_code.unit.

approvals.approval.label: STATUS
approvals.approval.description: Active, Expired, Superseded, Suspended, Withdrawn. Only Active is approved to ship; the system does not re-check the permit when it changes.

approvals.approval.label: CONDITIONS
approvals.approval.description: Conditions attached to the approval (retest frequency, volume cap).

approvals.approval_tolerance.label: PARAMETER
approvals.approval_tolerance.description: pH, Specific gravity, Total halogens, Flash point, Metals screen, PCB screen.

approvals.approval_tolerance.label: LOW
approvals.approval_tolerance.description: Lower bound, in the parameter's unit.

approvals.approval_tolerance.label: TOLERANCE BASIS
approvals.approval_tolerance.description: Internal tolerance or regulatory limit. An internal tolerance tighter than the permit is a business rule, not a regulatory one.

facility.facility.label: FACILITY NAME
facility.facility.description: Bayou Ridge Disposal, Sabine Fuels, Harbor Transfer.

facility.facility.label: FACILITY TYPE
facility.facility.description: Class I injection TSDF, Fuel-blending TSDF, 10-day transfer facility (not a TSDF).

facility.facility.label: MANAGEMENT METHOD
facility.facility.description: Management method code (H134, H061); none for a transfer facility.

facility.permit_version.label: APPROVED ON
facility.permit_version.description: Date the agency approved the version.

facility.permit_version.label: EFFECTIVE ON
facility.permit_version.description: Date the version applies in the business.

facility.permit_version.label: FILED ON
facility.permit_version.description: Date VLS filed the document to the repository — knowledge time, kept apart from effective time.

facility.permit_version.label: DOCUMENT REF
facility.permit_version.description: Controlled document in the permits folder.

facility.permit_unit_code.label: VERSION
facility.permit_unit_code.description: Permit version the row belongs to. Each version carries its full list of accepted codes for every unit, not only the rows it changed.

facility.permit_unit_code.label: WASTE CODE
facility.permit_unit_code.description: Accepted RCRA code. Entered by hand from the permit: M4 was entered on 3 Aug 2026, after its 1 Jul effective date.

facility.well.label: MAX RATE GPM
facility.well.description: Maximum injection rate, gallons per minute.

facility.exemption_limit.label: ITEM
facility.exemption_limit.description: Waste code or parameter (total halogenated organics, specific gravity …).

facility.exemption_limit.label: LIMIT VALUE
facility.exemption_limit.description: Concentration or physical limit; blank for a code that is simply listed.

receiving.manifest.label: manifest_tracking_no
receiving.manifest.description: e-Manifest tracking number (024121904GBF): 9 digits and 3 letters.

receiving.manifest.label: generator_epa_id
receiving.manifest.description: Generator EPA ID as written on the manifest. For a Harbor consolidation this is Harbor Transfer's ID, not the original generator's.

receiving.manifest.label: export_consent_no
receiving.manifest.description: Export consent number on export manifests (Sabine Fuels to Nuevo León); null otherwise.

receiving.manifest_line.label: quantity
receiving.manifest_line.description: Quantity as manifested, in the manifested unit.

receiving.manifest_line.label: unit
receiving.manifest_line.description: G (gallons), P (pounds), T (tons). Never add across units.

receiving.manifest_line.label: containers
receiving.manifest_line.description: Number of containers (drums, totes); 1 for a tanker.

receiving.manifest_line.label: profile_ref
receiving.manifest_line.description: Profile number written in the handling-codes box. Free text: 3.1% blank, some carry the Coastline number.

receiving.receipt.label: approval_id
receiving.receipt.description: Approval the load was accepted under. Null on 88 Harbor loads before cut-over (Coastline profiles).

receiving.receipt.label: received_at
receiving.receipt.description: Gate time. The Bayou Ridge gate runs 24/7.

receiving.receipt.label: net_weight_lb
receiving.receipt.description: Scale net weight, pounds. The scale owns weights.

receiving.receipt.label: gal_equivalent
receiving.receipt.description: Net weight converted to gallons at the profile's declared specific gravity × 8.345 lb/gal.

receiving.receipt.label: disposition
receiving.receipt.description: Accepted, Accepted pending retest, Rejected, Partially rejected, Held. 'Accepted pending retest' is not conforming.

receiving.receipt.label: receiving_note
receiving.receipt.description: Free text from the gate or lab ("retest requested").

receiving.fingerprint_result.label: parameter
receiving.fingerprint_result.description: pH, Specific gravity, Total halogens, Flash point, Metals screen, PCB screen. Fingerprints do not test for PFAS.

receiving.fingerprint_result.label: result
receiving.fingerprint_result.description: Measured value. The lab owns measured results.

receiving.fingerprint_result.label: status
receiving.fingerprint_result.description: Final, Pending, Retest. A pending result is not a pass.

receiving.discrepancy.label: significant
receiving.discrepancy.description: Significant under 40 CFR 264.72 (bulk > 10% by weight; any piece-count difference; type).

receiving.discrepancy.label: found_on
receiving.discrepancy.description: Discovery date — the day the 20-day clock starts.

receiving.discrepancy.label: status
receiving.discrepancy.description: Open, Resolved. Set by receiving; 'Resolved' is a system status, not evidence that the generator reconciled.

receiving.discrepancy.label: status_set_on
receiving.discrepancy.description: Date the status was last set.

receiving.discrepancy.label: emanifest_report_ref
receiving.discrepancy.description: e-Manifest discrepancy report reference, where one was filed. Null means no report on record here, not that none was filed.

receiving.rejection.label: onward_arranged_on
receiving.rejection.description: Date onward transport to an alternate facility or back to the generator was arranged (60-day window).

receiving.onward_shipment.label: onward_manifest
receiving.onward_shipment.description: New manifest Harbor started for the consolidated shipment. Null when the link was not recorded.

receiving.onward_shipment.label: onward_facility
receiving.onward_shipment.description: Destination (Bayou Ridge, Sabine Fuels, Gulfstar Thermal).

ops.injection_log.label: injectate_sg
ops.injection_log.description: Average specific gravity of the injectate.

ops.blend_batch.label: receipt_ids
ops.blend_batch.description: Receipts blended into the batch, comma-separated.

ops.fuel_shipment.label: kiln
ops.fuel_shipment.description: Receiving kiln (Pinecrest Cement, Sandhollow Cement, Cementos Sierra Norte).

ops.fuel_shipment.label: export
ops.fuel_shipment.description: True for shipments to Nuevo León under the export consent.

ops.certificate_of_disposal.label: disposal_method
ops.certificate_of_disposal.description: H134 injection, H061 blending then kiln.

billing.price_schedule.label: PRICE UNIT
billing.price_schedule.description: per gal, per drum, per load.

billing.invoice_line.label: RECEIPT ID
billing.invoice_line.description: Load invoiced. A load received on the 30th can be invoiced the next month.

billing.invoice_line.label: AMOUNT USD
billing.invoice_line.description: Invoiced amount, USD. Billing owns invoiced amounts.

billing.surcharge.label: SURCHARGE TYPE
billing.surcharge.description: Off-spec pH, Halogen, Solids, Demurrage, Resampling.

billing.surcharge.label: FINGERPRINT REF
billing.surcharge.description: Fingerprint result that supports it; null = unsupported by a result.

billing.surcharge.label: CONTRACT CLAUSE
billing.surcharge.description: Terms clause that allows it; null = unsupported by a clause.

sabine_billing.sf_customer.label: cust_name
sabine_billing.sf_customer.description: Customer name as Sabine spells it ('Brazos Bend Chem. Co.').

sabine_billing.sf_customer.label: epa_id
sabine_billing.sf_customer.description: Generator EPA ID. Blank on 5 accounts, including SF-0457 and the broker.

sabine_billing.sf_price.label: item
sabine_billing.sf_price.description: Item (Bulk solvent, Drum 55 gal, Halogenated drum …).

sabine_billing.sf_invoice_line.label: manifest_no
sabine_billing.sf_invoice_line.description: Manifest tracking number, typed in by billing; 2.4% blank.

coastline.ce_customer.label: ce_account
coastline.ce_customer.description: CE-2nnn account. Migrated customers kept the same number in VLS core.

coastline.ce_customer.label: name
coastline.ce_customer.description: Name in upper case as Coastline stored it.

coastline.ce_customer.label: migrated
coastline.ce_customer.description: True for the 7 customers moved to VLS core on 30 June.

coastline.ce_profile.label: ce_profile_no
coastline.ce_profile.description: Profile number. Same WP-nnnnn format as VLS core; WP-20233 means a different stream in each system.

coastline.ce_profile.label: cert_date
coastline.ce_profile.description: Certification date. No re-certification date was kept.

coastline.ce_shipment.label: gallons
coastline.ce_shipment.description: Gallons as Coastline recorded them (not reweighed).

coastline.ce_shipment.label: out_manifest
coastline.ce_shipment.description: Onward manifest the load left on. Null on 3.6% of rows.

coastline.ce_migration_map.label: legacy_key
coastline.ce_migration_map.description: CE account or CE profile number.

coastline.ce_migration_map.label: core_key
coastline.ce_migration_map.description: Account or profile in VLS core.
